page.layout: Running head at top with page number at top right. Intro paragraph at full width. Below it, two table columns side by side: Martius (left) and Aprilis (right). Notes in the left margin beside Martius rows 8 to 12 and 21 to 23. Small notes in the right margin beside Aprilis rows 6 to 9. Closing paragraph at full width below the table, then signature.

main_text.p: ingreessus fiat in tabellam subsequentem, & quo in loco is haerebit, ibi neomeniam Paschalem indicabit.
Exempli gratia, in anno Christi 1583 libet inuesti-gare locu neomeniae Paschalis:itaq; aureum numerũ anni praedicti, qui secūdum ordine enneadecaeteridis

page.notes: The Martius and Aprilis columns are set as cells separated by " | ". Marginal reference marks (* and ß) are placed as printed. The Aprilis row 5 Greek-like sign after XIV is transcribed as γ. The filled mark on Aprilis row 18 is transcribed as •, its exact form is uncertain. The left margin notes "Termi-nus fium-mus-meo-meniae Paschalis." and "Aequi-noctium vernum." are split across rows as printed. Several "o" entries in the tables are read from the scan and may be damaged.
